node.statement: The two fixed off-diagonal maps. By lem-maincb-cross-union-zero-corners, applied to the displayed A,w,U,V,R and t<=e_zero, S^A_{P_U,P_V}=S^A_{P_V,P_U}=0 and S^{A_R}_{P_U^R,P_V^R}=S^{A_R}_{P_V^R,P_U^R}=0. Therefore in each direction there is exactly one level-one linear map 0->0, namely the zero map. Lem-compcb-amplified-compression identifies every amplified target cross-corner with M_n tensor 0=0; lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities makes each compression an idempotent range projection and interchanges the two cross-corners under dagger. Consequently the amplification of each unique level-one zero map is again the unique map 0->0, so the same two fixed maps work at every amplification and have exactly zero star, product, and norm defect.
